summary: Final correction is a two-hunk, production-only change to packages/node/src/v3-live.ts on top of a genuine tests-only causal RED. RED a19e8454 touched only tests/phase-3g-v3-rebase-outbox-red.test.ts and tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b0b-node-corrective-red.test.ts, selected exactly 27, and failed exactly 3 with 3 AssertionError occurrences and zero module/setup errors: legacy structural causalJoin retirement, legacy join retirement, legacy nonterminal ambiguity result kind. GREEN 802a647e changed only production (git diff --name-only a19e8454..802a647e = 1 production path plus RED evidence), and focused27.json shows all three formerly-failing titles now passed with 27/27, 40/40, 87/87, 26/26, 64/64, 14/14, built-child 1/1 (16 filtered) and matching detached-checkout gates from /private/tmp/ts-drp-d110c-final-compat.CPbyQ1/checkout. Hunk 2 restores pre-f5b0b legacy rebase behavior exactly: at 504ca351 rebaseIntents returned ObjectFreeze([]) for every reserved batch action, and the current predicate (v3-live.ts:6798-6805) yields the identical result for any non-v1 profile since settlementProfileFor only returns v1 for creator-trusted-settlement-v1; RESERVED_BATCH_ACTIONS is unchanged from the baseline, and tests/phase-3g-v3-rebase-outbox-red.test.ts is now byte-identical to 504ca351 (git diff 504ca351..802a647e on that path is empty), so the retained assertion was restored rather than weakened. Live legacy accounting is untouched: isControlOperation (v3-live.ts:3502-3507) short-circuits false for non-v1, so ingress reservation/ACL staging/sink (3954-4056), local issue (6301-6309), journal replay and recovery (5540-5836) still treat valid legacy join/causalJoin as application operations, and validRebaseRow's acceptedApplicationOperation path (6757-6775) is unchanged for legacy. Settlement control-only behavior is intact and matches design.md:204-207 and RED case 21: v1 fence/join/causalJoin return [] via isControlOperation, control vertices skip reservation, ACL staging and the sink (4045/4056), displaced acl surfacing is the designed exception pinned by tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b0b-node-red.test.ts:361, and malformed causalJoin ABI still refuses at both local generation and signed ingress. Hunk 1 (v3-live.ts:6438) leaves the terminal branch at 6431-6437 first so the outcome-unknown latch keeps precedence, keeps settlement nonterminal ambiguity at issuance-rejected (pinned by node-red.test.ts:211-232, which would fail on admission-rejected without the v1 arm), and lets legacy nonterminal ambiguity fall through to the unchanged parent ternary, reproducing 504ca351 byte-for-byte including the halt at 6428-6430. Earlier blocker closures verified in source and in the passing focused set: same-store seq0 surfaces because the seq0 skip at 6950-6956 is gated on crossSource, the activation-digest exclusion is universal, the recovery issued/outbox cross-check at 5655-5667 is unconditional, malformed durable plans fail typed through copySettlementPlan at 6595-6604, and fence refusal plus admission halt are intact at 6588-6611. Scope holds: the whole final cycle (fa4ee8f3..52d1819f) touches only one production file and two test files, with no package.json, lockfile, protobuf, wire, schema, threshold, room, pruning, W0 or lineagePolicy change, and no stop rule for contiguity, plan authority or anchor fencing is engaged. Evidence is honest: the focused39/40 command-name mismatch and the Prettier-only reformat are both disclosed, node typecheck exit 2 is inherited with byte-identical normalized outputs (diff of the two .normalized files is empty, SHA f1fe7cb5, no v3-live diagnostics), the stale-dist artifacts stay confined to the immutable prior pack .logs/d110c-0c1f5b0b-green-e07f8a94 and are not claimed as gates here, and every reporter in the final pack reports success true with counts matching result.json. Working tree is clean on tracked paths and HEAD equals origin at 52d1819f.

findings.title: Final GREEN pack drops the dist-identity artifact that the prior pack carried after the stale-dist incident
findings.evidence: .logs/d110c-0c1f5b0b-green-802a647e/commands.md:41-54 asserts in prose that the Node and protocol-v3 builds ran 'Before any fresh child', but the pack contains no dist-identity.txt or built-output audit, unlike .logs/d110c-0c1f5b0b-green-e07f8a94/dist-identity.txt which was added precisely because a child test had imported a stale packages/node/dist. source-audit.txt only describes the two source hunks. The in-repo packages/node/dist/src/v3-live.js mtime (Sep 4 07:24) also precedes the final source mtime (07:25, the Prettier reformat), so the pack alone does not establish that shared64.json and built-child.json exercised the 802a647e semantics. Verified independently and materially sound: the built file carries both hunks (dist/src/v3-live.js:4959-4962 has the issuanceOutcomeUnknown && settlementProfileFor(...) === 'v1' gate, and :5226-5231 has the reverted rebase predicate with no causalJoin/join exemptions), and the detached run in isolated-built-child.json rebuilt dependencies from the committed tree at /private/tmp/ts-drp-d110c-final-compat.CPbyQ1/checkout and passed 1/1.
findings.required_action: No change to this closed slice. Restore a dist-identity/built-output hash record in future GREEN packs whose gates import built Node output, so build-before-child identity is provable from the pack without external re-verification.
